assumptions.statement: The submitted site boundary and the three key-area polygons are the repository's provisional rough polygons (PROV-SITE-001 / PROV-KEY-001/002/003), not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All geometry, areas, ratios, figures, PDFs, and HTML must be recalculated after an official or cleared boundary is supplied; until then the package is reviewable for content but not for precise statutory area claims.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Floor area ratio, building height, building density, green ratio, and setback controls are absent from the public site package; building footprints in geometry/buildings.geojson are conceptual massing, not approved scale.
assumptions.impact: Any intensity, height, or demolition/renovation/retention conclusion is a design suggestion for professional deepening and must not be read as a regulatory decision.

assumptions.statement: Naming, logo direction, scenario cards, personas, landmarks, cultural narrative, annual events, and developer-community mechanisms are open co-creation suggestions, not confirmed government programs or funding commitments.
assumptions.impact: Operational and brand content requires organizer and rights-holder approval before any real deployment; no implementation guarantee is claimed.

assumptions.statement: Every AI scenario is designed around data minimization, public or authorized data only, explainability, and mandatory human review; no scenario depends on undisclosed personal profiling or pervasive surveillance.
assumptions.impact: Scenarios remain reviewable concept designs; any deployment must pass separate privacy, security, and legal assessment.
